primary_msc_basis: The principal theorem concerns attainability and speed limits for chiral continuous-time quantum-information transport, a quantum-network control problem; graph colourings are its classification mechanism. The cited foundational paper itself lists both graph-theory and quantum-information MSC classifications.
scientific_integrity: The analytic theorem concerns zero-diagonal unit-modulus Hermitian adjacency controls and apex-started swift transport only; exact finite checks corroborate but do not prove the all-graph statement. The classification is not asserted for arbitrary on-site potentials, bond magnitudes, or instantaneous orthogonality without the swift law. Broader unit-gain spectral literature may bear on originality.
scientific_limitations: Unrestricted within finite connected simple cubic original graphs and their single subdivisions. The circle parametrization is in a fixed apex gauge and is not a quotient by further physical equivalences.
title: Swift chiral transport on cones over subdivided cubic networks
